stations.title: Gethin
stations.say: Can the screens keep the listings?

stations.title: Studio screens
stations.text: Fetch the whole listings every ten seconds.

stations.title: Cupboard server
stations.text: Says how long its listings may be kept.

captions: Gethin asks whether the four studio screens can stop fetching the same listings all day.
Each screen throws away the copy it has and fetches the whole listings every ten seconds.
You read cache-control, tell fresh from stale and ask if a copy changed, in four tasks.
Each screen shows its own copy while it is fresh, and asks a short question after that.
Part 3 begins: an answer says how long it may be kept, and an etag asks if it changed.
